event.title: Boston Graduate Fair - Fall 2026
event.description:
Thinking about graduate school but unsure if it’s the right step? Join us for an informal, on-campus Graduate Fair designed to help you explore your options and ger honest answers about what graduate study can mean for your future.

 

Graduate Fair Fall 2026 

Date: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 

Time: 4:00–8:00 p.m. ET  

Location: Northeastern University Alumni Center, 6th floor, 716 Columbus Avenue

 

The Double Husky Scholarship provides aid to Northeastern alumni who wish to continue their graduate studies on campus. Come learn more about it and discover how you can continue your Northeastern education while advancing your academic and career goals. 

 

At the fair, you can expect to: 

  • Meet with representatives from colleges and campuses to find the graduate program that align with your goals. 
  • Learn how to unlock the Double Husky Scholarship—a 25% tuition discount on 120+ eligible programs. 
  • Explore the PlusOne pathway to accelerate your degree and begin graduate coursework early. 
  • Discover the benefits of Northeastern’s global campus network across the U.S., U.K., and Canada. 
  • Enjoy free food, complimentary professional headshots, win giveaways, and pick up Northeastern swag. 

Whether you're actively planning for grad school or just exploring options, we’re here to help you!

 

This event is open to students of all majors. Can’t wait to see you there – register today.

event.title: Sharing Community Histories Showcase
event.location: Cabral Center, Northeastern University Boston Campus
event.location_name: Cabral Center, Northeastern University Boston Campus
event.description: The Sharing Community Histories Showcase fosters practice and knowledge exchanges about community-engaged projects out of the humanities and arts. Talks and posters will feature projects that Boston-area community partners, college teachers and students have co-created. We hope you leave this event both inspired and with a few more Boston-area contacts.
